mapper.select: SELECT id, summary_id, session_id, user_id, summary_ref, version_no, source_turn_count, source_latest_turn_id, source_latest_turn_no, status, created_at, updated_at FROM agent_session_task_summary WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY version_no DESC, updated_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_session_task_summary SET status = 'SUPERSEDED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
